column7: postJSONToURL named a failed delivery's destination with url.URL.Redacted(), which masks only userinfo, so a channel URL's path token (Slack-style tokens live in the path, and the URL is a bearer credential) reached the returned error and the log lines built from it by alert escalation and the recover-admin broadcast, both for a receiver 5xx and, wrapped in the http.Client *url.Error, for any transport failure; parseWebhookURLLiteral also echoed the raw URL with %q and the wrapped url.Parse error on the send-time path and in the 400 body at create/update. Confirmed red before the fix (token present in the error and in a captured log line for receiver 500, transport error, refused stored URLs, both dispatch log sites and the validation error). Fixed by naming the destination as scheme+host only (netutil.RedactURLHost, now shared with notifychan) and stripping the *url.Error layer from the cause (netutil.RedactErrorURLs, which keeps errors.Is on the underlying failure).
